summary: Capricor Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting the entry into a lease agreement for a new headquarters in San Diego. The lease for 171,000 rentable square feet at $5.60 per square foot will begin upon FDA approval by December 31, 2026, or earlier date, with rent commencing 12 months later on a 138-month term, an 18-month full abatement and six-month partial abatement. The registrant is the tenant. This is a routine real estate contract with a regulatory contingency, not a special situation transaction. No deal terms apply.
